title: Readwise Review Streak Reliability
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:highlight review_weekday=* streak_held=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(streak_held="yes",1,0))) as matched by review_weekday
| eval the_streak_held_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - the_streak_held_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Readwise review days that end with the streak held by weekday.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which weekday are helping or hurting Readwise review days.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `the streak held` on `reading:highlight` events and summarize the hit rate by `review_weekday`.
visualization: Table of weekday with percentage of Readwise review days ending with the streak held.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how often the streak held happens for each weekday so you can see where Readwise review days go smoothly or get stuck.
